_readme: What a supporter confirms before accepting a task (PLAN 13c, Aura 2026-11-16). Served by GET /tasks/:id/accept-requirements; the app shows what it is sent, so wording, which task asks for what, and how often are changed HERE, with no app release.

Keys: 'baseline' (every supporter), one per playbook id (llm/playbooks.json) for the task's type, 'other' when no playbook matches, 'home_entry' on top when the task's words send the supporter inside a home (scope_rules.home_entry).
when: 'once' = asked until accepted at this version; 'always' = asked on every accept (the pilot's rule, Aura 2026-11-16).
version: bump it whenever title or body changes. Acceptances are recorded with the version and a hash of the text shown.
STATUS 2026-11-16: wording is a draft pending legal review.
heading: Before you accept

baseline.title: Before your first task
baseline.body:
You decide how to get there and you take care on the way. Walk, take transit, bike or drive as you choose; if you drive, you use your own insured vehicle and never carry the requester or anyone else.

Never carry more than you can carry safely: if something is too heavy, text the requester before you try.

Keep every receipt and photograph it before you hand anything over.

You can decline any task, and you can stop a task and leave at any moment if you feel unsafe. Tell HO:RA through the app when you do.

groceries.title: Groceries & items
groceries.body:
Buy only what is on the list, within the budget. If something is out or a swap is needed, text the requester before you change anything.

You can go up to $5 over the budget without asking. Anything more needs their OK in the chat first, or it may not be reimbursed.

Never buy alcohol, tobacco, vapes, cannabis or anything that needs an ID check, even if asked.

If the load is too heavy to carry safely, tell the requester before you buy it.

food.title: Food & drinks
food.body:
Never promise that food is safe for an allergy. If the requester names one, you can ask the staff and pass on exactly what they said, nothing more.

Carry hot food and drinks lidded and upright, and go straight to the drop-off.

Never open, taste or repack an order. If something isn't available, text the requester before you swap it.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy: over-the-counter only
pharmacy.body:
Buy over-the-counter items only, exactly as the requester named them.

Never pick up a prescription, never show anyone's ID or insurance card, and never suggest which medicine to take or how much.

If the pharmacist asks about the requester's health, say you're running an errand and text the requester. What you learn about their health stays between you and them.

laundry.title: Laundry & dry cleaning
laundry.body:
Check every pocket before anything goes in. Anything you find (cash, cards, keys, anything sharp) is set aside, photographed and reported to the requester.

Photograph the bags or items when you collect them and when you hand them back.

You are not responsible for what the laundry or dry cleaner does to a garment.

packages.title: Packages & returns
packages.body:
Only carry a box that is sealed and labelled, or a return with its label or QR code.

Don't carry anything that leaks, smells of chemicals or that you suspect is hazardous (loose lithium batteries, flammables, aerosols). Text the requester instead.

Photograph the box and the drop-off receipt every time.

small_services.title: Keys, repairs & tailoring
small_services.body:
Never sign anything for the requester (claim tickets, waivers, repair agreements). If the shop asks for a signature, text the requester.

Never unlock, open or look through anyone's phone.

House keys stay with you only for the errand: don't copy more than asked, don't label them with an address, and hand them back to the requester or the person they name. Keep the claim ticket and photograph it.

check.title: Checking & waiting in line
check.body:
Dress for the weather. You can leave the line if it becomes unsafe or you feel unwell; tell the requester.

Don't argue with staff or others in line. If you're asked to leave, leave.

Photos are of the sign, the shelf or the length of the line, from a public spot, never of people's faces.

Never buy anything to resell, and follow the venue's rules about holding a place.

friend.title: Pick up from or drop off with someone
friend.body:
Hand the item only to the adult the requester named, and ask for their first name before you do.

Don't go inside unless the task says so.

If you don't know what's in a bag or box and it looks or feels wrong, don't take it and text the requester.

Never take sides or pass on messages beyond what the task says.

gifts.title: Gifts & occasions
gifts.body:
Use the recipient's name and address only for this delivery.

If the recipient refuses the delivery or seems upset by it, don't insist: leave and tell the requester.

Handle flowers and cakes with care and photograph them at hand-off.

companionship.title: Company in a public place
companionship.body:
Meet the requester at the public place named in the task and stay in public places.

Never go into a home, a hotel, a car or anywhere private, never a bar or a club, and never drink alcohol. Only the requester; no one else along.

Any romantic, sexual or physical request ends the task: leave and report it to HO:RA in the app.

other.title: Before you accept
other.body:
Do only what the task describes. If the requester asks for something else once you're there, text them in the chat first so it's on the record.

Keep every receipt and photograph each hand-off.

You can stop and leave at any moment if you feel unsafe. Tell HO:RA through the app.

home_entry.title: This task goes inside a home
home_entry.body:
Go inside only for the errand in the task, and only that errand.

The requester or an adult they name is there, or the task gives clear access (a doorman, a lockbox, "the bag is by the door"). You are never alone with a child: if no adult is there, don't go in.

Don't open drawers, cupboards or rooms the errand doesn't need. Photograph where you left things before you leave. If anything feels wrong, leave and tell HO:RA through the app.
